summary:
Frontend-only verification of K5 Confidence Envelope + K8 Event signal v2 + K4 Cancellation model v2 evidence tooltips inside Market Robot → AI Pricing sub-tab. All requested items PASS. Nav: landing → Sign In → login (admin@hotelbox.com) → PRO pill → branch selector (had to switch from 'All Branches' to 'Franziskaner by Centra' — the AI Pricing panel refuses to render suggestions on the 'all' branch, showing 'AI Pricing motoru için lütfen bir otel seçin'; expected/by design in AIPricingEnginePanel line 60/72) → sidebar 'Revenue management' → tab data-testid='rev-tab-market-robot' → sub-tab data-testid='market-robot-ai-pricing' (renders AIPricingEnginePanel).

RESULTS (Franziskaner by Centra / Zurich):
- 60 suggestion rows rendered without crash, all with data-testid ai-pricing-row-{i}.
- ai-pricing-conf-{i} present on ALL 60 rows: 60 emerald (>=70%), 0 amber, 0 stone. Sample values G%70, G%85, G%90 — matches backend K5 spec.
- ai-pricing-event-{i} present on 4 rows. Row 6 & 7 = 2026-08-18 both show violet '🎫+%15' with title "Etkinlik boost'u: +%15" — confirms K8 capacity-weighted stadium concert boost. Row 34 (2026-09-01) shows '🎫+%0.8' (smaller event). Suggested rate for 2026-08-18 = CHF 214 (backend-reported 213.93 rounded) ✓.
- Row hover evidence tooltip: 60/60 rows contain 'İptal modeli örneklemi güçlü (317 rezervasyon)' in title attribute (K4 evidence). Sample: 'İptal modeli örneklemi güçlü (317 rezervasyon) · Tarihte 6 aktif rezervasyon (OTB sinyali) · Yakın tarih (3g) — pickup verisi taze · Etkinlik sinyali: kapasite ağırlıklı +%15 boost'.
- Faded rows (opacity-45 grayscale, confidence<0.5): 0 — as expected per problem statement (no low-confidence rows in current data). Code path exists at line 451.
- REGRESSION passing: existing columns render (LEAD, TALEP, DOLULUK, PAZAR ORT, MEVCUT, ÖNERİ, NET KÂR, Δ%, GEREKÇE, DURUM). 60 ai-pricing-net-{i} cells rendered. 63 accept/apply buttons ('Kabul') still visible. Filter tabs 'Tümü (60) / Auto Uygun (2) / İnceleme (58) / Bekliyor (59) / Uygulanan (1)' render. Header KPIs: Toplam Öneri 60, Auto Uygun 2, Manuel İnceleme 58, Ort Δ +41.53%, Tahmini Uplift CHF 2,824.
- Trust Center regression: sidebar 'Robot Güven Merkezi' opens; tc-netotb-chart=1, tc-acceptance-section=1, tc-up-input=1, tc-viol-table=1 — all render OK. Net OTB chart renders 14-day Brüt/Net dual-line (net_otb v2 API change did not break UI). Guardrail inputs still show max_up=15, max_down=10, daily=50 (from iter 543). Violation ledger shows KILL SWITCH + ADIM LİMİTİ rows.
- Per instruction: did NOT click Kabul/Uygula on any suggestion (guardrail daily limit protected). Did NOT run scan.
- Console: only pre-login 401s (unrelated). One React hydration warning in AIPricingV2Panel (different panel, not the tested one) about <span> inside <option> — NOT introduced by this iteration but flagged below.

critical_code_review_comments: AIPricingEnginePanel refuses to render when propertyId === 'all' (line 60, 72 return early). Tester must know to switch branch; consider showing a friendlier prompt or auto-picking first property to reduce onboarding friction.

The row-level tooltip (title attribute on <tr>) contains the same evidence string as the confidence badge title — potential UX enhancement: show 'Düşük güven' prefix on badge tooltip only when confidence < 0.5 (already done for row), keep badge tooltip cleaner.
Unrelated: AIPricingV2Panel line 103 emits React hydration error for <span> inside <option>. Should be plain text child in <option>.
